note_on_method: Each venue page rests on one line of the City of Wichita's Pickleball page: a name, a street line, in most cases a phone number, and a count, under one of three tabs whose headings say whether the courts are indoor or outdoor. The US Census address geocoder and OpenStreetMap supply the county and the postcode. The City's page could not be fetched by any script, so it was read in a browser on 7 September 2026 and saved as text. Where the City is silent, these pages record the silence, and where the Census added a compass direction the City does not write, they say which resolver's answer is published and why.

slots.description:
Fifteen pickleball courts at one address, the largest count in Wichita. The City writes this venue twice on its Pickleball page. On the Parks tab, under "Outdoor courts with hard / concrete surfaces", the line is "Edgemoor Park / 5815 E 9th / 12 courts". On the Recreation Centers tab, under "Temporary indoor courts with wood and tile surfaces", it is "Edgemoor / 5815 E 9th Street / 316-688-9392 / 3 courts". Same address, one site, and both lines are printed here so the sum can be checked.

Twelve outdoor courts is the largest outdoor set in the city. The City says nothing else about the place: no hours for the park, no drop-in times for the centre beyond two PDFs not read for this page, no lighting, no price, and no surface for this venue on its own.
slots.getting_there:
5815 E 9th, Wichita, KS 67208, as the Parks tab writes it; the Recreation Centers tab writes "5815 E 9th Street". OpenStreetMap matched the address at house-number level as "5815, East 9th Street North, Country Side, Minneha, Wichita, Sedgwick County, Kansas, 67208". The US Census geocoder answered "5815 E 9TH ST N", adding a North the City does not write, so the address publishes as the City writes it.

The City publishes nothing about parking or restrooms. The phone number on the centre's line is 316-688-9392.
slots.what_to_expect:
Outdoors, twelve courts with no stated hours, no stated lighting and no stated price. It is the one outdoor set in Wichita large enough that turning up alone is a reasonable plan on the count alone.

Indoors, three courts the City calls temporary, laid out in the centre for drop-in sessions rather than built into the floor. The sessions are in the City's summer and fall drop-in PDFs, which this site has not read, so no time is published here. Nothing is said about when the outdoor courts are busy, or whether nets are provided.

slots.description:
Two outdoor pickleball courts, on one line of the City's Parks tab: "Buffalo Park / 10201 Hardtner / 2 courts", under the heading "Outdoor courts with hard / concrete surfaces". That is the whole of the City's published record of pickleball at this park. No hours, no phone number, no lighting and no price.

Two courts is a game rather than a rotation: four players fill it and a fifth waits, so this is a venue for a group that arrives together. The address is the fact verification changed most. The imported dataset held this park at "318-500 N Maize Rd", a range along a road rather than a house number, and the City's "10201 Hardtner" replaced it.
slots.getting_there:
10201 Hardtner, Wichita, KS 67212. The US Census address geocoder matched "10201 HARDTNER ST, WICHITA, KS, 67212" at house-number level and placed it in Sedgwick County, inside the incorporated place Wichita city; no second resolver was needed. Buffalo Park and Orchard Recreation Center are the two published venues in 67212.

The City publishes nothing about parking or restrooms at this park, and no phone number for it; the Parks tab gives none of its four parks a number.
slots.what_to_expect:
Two courts, outdoors, and a City record that stops there. Hours are not stated, so this site cannot say when the park opens or closes. Lighting is not stated, so evening play is an open question rather than a no. Price is not stated, and the City's one sentence on cost does not name a venue. Surface is not stated for this park on its own.

With two courts and no published session, nothing on the City's record suggests a rotation forms here, so bring your four. If both courts are taken, the same tab lists Osage's two, Seneca's six and Edgemoor's twelve.

slots.description:
Three indoor pickleball courts at the Boston Recreation Center, from the line "Boston / 6655 E Zimmerly / 316-688-9301 / 3 courts" on the City's Recreation Centers tab, under the heading "Temporary indoor courts with wood and tile surfaces".

Three courts is the joint-largest indoor count among Wichita's six recreation centres, level with Edgemoor, Linwood and Orchard. The word that matters is "Temporary": these are courts laid out in the gym for drop-in sessions rather than built into the floor, and the sessions are published in two PDFs the tab links, "View Summer Drop-In Hours" and "View Fall Drop-In Hours", which this site has not read. The City states no price for this centre and no surface of its own.

slots.description:
Fifteen pickleball courts at the City's Riverside Tennis Center, and the only venue in Wichita where the City answers the lighting question. Its tab reads, in full: "551 Nims / Phone: 316-337-9257 / 9 outdoors with court lights for night play / 6 indoors (these are double-striped over the 3 tennis courts)", followed by two links, "Reserve a Pickleball Court" and "Take Pickleball Lessons". Nine and six are the City's figures; fifteen is their sum.

The six indoor courts are pickleball lines painted over three indoor tennis courts, so what you find inside depends on whether tennis is being played on the same floor. With Edgemoor's fifteen it is the joint-largest venue in the city, and it is the one with a published reservation link.

The US Census address geocoder matched "551 NIMS ST, WICHITA, KS, 67203" at house-number level and placed it in Sedgwick County, inside the incorporated place Wichita city; the street type is the only thing the Census adds, and no second resolver was needed. Riverside is the only published Wichita venue in 67203.

The City publishes nothing about parking or restrooms. It does publish a phone number, 316-337-9257, on the same line as the counts, and a "Reserve a Pickleball Court" link.
slots.what_to_expect:
Nine outdoor courts under lights, which the City states as "for night play", and six indoor courts sharing a floor with tennis. The City prints no opening or closing time for the centre.

On cost, "Some can be reserved for a small fee while others are first-come-first-serve" is written for the whole city, and the "Reserve a Pickleball Court" link sits on this tab, but the fee itself is not printed, so no price publishes here. Nine lit courts is a rotation after dark, the only one in Wichita with a published lighting answer. Ring 316-337-9257 or use the reservation link; the surface of the outdoor courts is not stated.

faqs.a: The six indoor courts are pickleball lines laid over the three indoor tennis courts, so they share a floor with tennis and exist when tennis is not on it.

faqs.q: Why is the older name not used?
faqs.a: The imported dataset holds "Ralph Wulz Riverside Tennis Center" with thirteen courts. The City's page prints "Riverside Tennis Center" and fifteen, and the City's record publishes.
